top_choice_rationale: Buchwald and Hartwig solved the hard step in Pd-catalysed C-N coupling (reductive elimination from a Pd amido complex) through ligand design, a chemically new and general method that is three decades mature, with a clean two-name allocation and a citation that can acknowledge the Kosugi tin-amide precedent. P001 (degraders and cereblon glues) is the strongest conceptual alternative but its citation joins two strands and no heterobifunctional degrader is approved; P003 is mature but credit among sequencing lineages is contested; P004 has uneven in-cell evidence. A prize is preferable to no award.
